title: Responses stream faults lack diagnostic context and get rendered as interrupted
wanted_capability: When a Responses HTTP-SSE stream dies after partial output, preserve enough context to diagnose it: upstream request id if available, response id if seen, last SSE event type/sequence, attempt count, bytes/events consumed, emitted_text/terminal_seen, and surface a fleet activity label distinct from user interruption.
fallback_used: Manually inspected harness session JSONL and transport source; current UI only exposed an ambiguous 'activity interrupted' label.
resolution_note: Addressed in worktree /home/invidious/repos/transcript-search-responses-idiomatic: HTTP-SSE stream faults now include request_id, response_id, last typed event + sequence, attempt/max attempts, bytes consumed, emitted_text, and terminal_seen in retry logs and terminal errors; fleet TUI now renders failed tasks as Failed instead of Interrupted so transport failures are distinct from operator cancellation; Responses WebSocket path now handles documented previous_response_not_found by retrying full input without previous_response_id and treats websocket_connection_limit_reached as a transport fallback to HTTP-SSE. Verified with cargo check -p bro-harness -p bro-cli and cargo nextest run --workspace (4024 passed, 24 skipped).
